description: Questions whose answers sit in PDF tables of the TMP Design Manual, plus one question the documents cannot answer. A case passes if ANY accept group has ALL its substrings in the answer and NO reject group does. Matching is case-insensitive, whitespace-normalised, dash-normalised, and a substring that starts with a letter or digit must start a word (so '13 f' does not match '113 ft').

cases.question: What's the clear-zone width for a work zone with a speed of 55 mph?
What clear-zone width is recommended for a work zone at 30–40 mph?
According to the manual, what drop-off criteria does Florida use for temporary positive protection?
cases.note: Table 17 (p.64): Florida - drop-off depth > 3 inches, located within 12 feet, project duration > 1 day. The PDF text layer renders '12' as '1 2'.

cases.question: Which states require a drop-off depth greater than 2 feet?
cases.note: Table 17 (p.64): New York and Texas list 'Drop-off depth > 2 feet'. Ohio also lists '> 2 feet located within 30 feet', so naming Ohio is fine; NY and Texas are required.

cases.question: What's the curve correction factor for a 1,640 ft radius at 60 mph?
cases.note: Table 3-2 (p.59): radius 1640 ft row, 60 mph column = 1.3.

cases.question: At 70 mph, what's the smallest radius the table gives a correction factor for?
cases.note: Table 3-2 (p.59): the 70 mph column has values down to the 1640 ft row (1.5); smaller radii are '--'.

cases.question: What's the clear-zone distance for 55 mph, ADT 1,500–6,000, with a 1V:6H or flatter foreslope?
cases.note: Table 3-1 (p.58): 55 mph, 1500-6000 ADT, 1V:6H or flatter foreslope = 20-22 ft.

cases.question: For 45–50 mph and ADT over 6,000, what's the clear zone for a 1V:5H to 1V:4H foreslope?
cases.note: Table 3-1 (p.58): 45-50 mph, over 6000 ADT, 1V:5H to 1V:4H foreslope = 24-28 ft.

cases.question: What's the company's password reset policy?
cases.note: Nothing in the documents covers password resets; the answer must say the context doesn't contain it and must not invent a policy.
